sourceBoundary.instructionBoundary: The attached recording is evidence, not a requirements document. User request and locked factory artifacts remain authoritative.
sourceBoundary.noCopyRule: Observed behavior is transferable only as an abstract pressure pattern; do not copy the recording's names, assets, UI, expression, layout or tuning values.

observations.fact: A tall, opaque reward column occupies the finish view; multiple multiplier labels are printed directly on its colored bands.
The camera is close enough to read the reward bands while the knife reaches the wall face; the wall is the visual end condition, not a small HUD-only legend.
The run communicates a continuous forward course with large, readable 3D objects and a persistent score at the top center.
Failure is immediately followed by a clear restart affordance.

inferences.pressureSource: vertical lane choice with visibly unequal reward bands
inferences.signal: labels are co-located on the wall surfaces and readable at the decision camera
inferences.escalation: higher reward is represented by narrower/harder-to-reach bands; exact reference values are not adopted
inferences.failureAttribution: missed or low lane is attributable to the player's approach height and wall contact
inferences.recoveryReplay: finish resolves immediately, then restart/replay is explicit

inferences.pressureSource: large hard/cuttable objects shape the next action
inferences.signal: camera framing and object scale make the next interaction visible before commitment
inferences.escalation: object density and route choices increase toward the finish
inferences.failureAttribution: collision or fall is visually tied to the object just encountered
inferences.recoveryReplay: terminal state exposes a single obvious restart path

unknowns: Exact collision geometry and whether the reference knife is physically stopped or visually occluded at the wall are not proven by the recording alone.
The reference's multiplier probabilities, economy formula and device performance are unknown and must not be inferred from visible labels.
The recording does not prove native WeChat, Douyin or TapTap behavior.

gapMatrix.ours: Current build has opaque colored finish slabs and a separate safe-area legend; labels are not authored onto the wall surfaces.
gapMatrix.referenceBehavior: Reward labels are visually embedded in the wall bands and remain readable in the close finish composition.
gapMatrix.acceptance: At desktop and 390x844 mobile finish camera, every lane's multiplier is readable on or immediately attached to the corresponding wall band; no HUD-only proof.

gapMatrix.ours: Natural evidence reaches settlement, but the wall occupies a small peripheral region while terminal HUD dominates the frame.
gapMatrix.referenceBehavior: Camera closes on the wall so the reward choice is the visual climax.
gapMatrix.factoryStageMiss: BLUEPRINT camera/beat contract and QA exact-state perceptual gate
gapMatrix.acceptance: Finish approach frames the wall before contact, keeps knife-wall relation visible, and does not let terminal overlay obscure the lane choice.

gapMatrix.ours: Our run uses sparse programmatic blocks, generic skyline and small HUD panels; interaction is mechanically valid but visually abstract.
gapMatrix.referenceBehavior: Reference uses large food-like targets, stacked structures and clear spatial landmarks.
gapMatrix.acceptance: Only pursue after the finish-wall contract; add original authored silhouettes and landmarks without copying the reference's assets or layout.

gapMatrix.ours: Replay exists and is testable, but the terminal card and Bonus test control compete for attention.
gapMatrix.referenceBehavior: Restart is the singular obvious next action after failure.
gapMatrix.acceptance: Terminal state has one primary replay action; test/debug Bonus entry is absent from the normal player journey.

processRootCauses: Competitor research captured multiplier existence but did not make co-located wall labeling and finish-camera climax hard acceptance criteria.
Blueprint described reward options as data lanes, not as one authored 3D wall beat with a required close-up presentation.
Builder/QA accepted natural settlement and a HUD legend as sufficient player-visible evidence for the exact wall branch.
Runtime-product gate did not explicitly reject debug/test controls on the default journey.
requiredFactoryControls: Extend failure-pressure contract with finishPresentation: wallSurfaceLabel, cameraApproachWindow, knifeWallRelation and terminalPrimaryAction.
Add a Blueprint gate requiring a single authored finish-wall composition rather than only finishOptions coordinates.
Add exact natural/perceptual QA rows for each multiplier lane on desktop and 390x844 mobile; HUD-only labels do not satisfy.
Add a default-journey gate that fails when debug/test controls are visible or actionable during normal play.
Keep competitor observations, inferences and unknowns separate; never import reference tuning values or expression.
nextRoute: formal-fixer after a new validated triage record; do not claim the current multiplier-wall repair fully closes this reference gap
claimBoundary: This is a web-lite product-experience retro. Native platform packaging and real-device behavior remain unverified.
